what: Toll v3 pays Circle test USDC on Base Sepolia through NEAR Chain Signatures. The contract itself builds USDC.transfer(to, value) (value 0 ETH, gas <= 100000) after its oath checks pass; only then does it ask v1.signer-prod.testnet to sign. This is a direct ERC-20 transfer signed by the MPC, not EIP-3009 and not an x402 facilitator.

not_done: Broadcast and settle. The derived address 0x2010…b036 has 0 test USDC (checked 2026-10-28 22:55 Cairo, UTC+3): the faucet USDC went to the first Toll's address 0xfbd3…254e, and that Toll (v2) signs native ETH transfers only and has no upgrade method, so those 20 USDC stay there by design. When 0x2010…b036 holds >= 0.5 USDC, the signed tx above is broadcast unchanged and settle(0) proves it through the MPC (domain 3, Base).
